title: Cortex Task Envelope
description: The universal task contract (canonical home: cortex/contracts/, per ADR-0014). Every task — regardless of executing agent — is one of these. agent-fabric imports this; adapters translate it into whatever each agent expects. Nothing downstream invents its own shape. (ADR-0023: the in-process engine supersedes the retired n8n spine.)

id.description: Stable id; adapters must be idempotent against it.

project.description: Coarse routing label; maps to a Mnemos container root and is carried through decomposition.

source.description: Originating surface; clarifications route back here.

prompt.description: full instruction for the executing agent

status.description: Consolidated ≤8-state lifecycle (2026-06-10). Two pure substates were folded: the former 'dispatched' is 'running' with started_at unset (claimed-but-not-started); the former 'needs_review' is 'reviewing' with review.needs_human=true (human escalation, not auto-grader).

acceptance_criteria.description: checkable done-conditions the grader scores against (must include a verification method)

review.description: Grader output. needs_human=true marks the escalation that was formerly the 'needs_review' status (retries/grade exhausted -> a human, not the auto-grader); review_outcome records why the task is in 'reviewing'.

assigned_agent.description: Universal superset; agent-fabric executor supports a subset (openclaw|hermes|codex|claude). Adapters own the name mapping.

node.description: fleet node the agent-fabric worker runs on

workflowId.description: Dynamic-workflow-engine extension (agent-fabric src/workflows/). Set when this envelope is a node in a runtime-authored workflow DAG; null for plain spine tasks. Join key for per-workflow receipts/checkpoints.

nodeId.description: Dynamic-workflow-engine extension. The DAG node id (workflow-definition node) this envelope executes. Null outside the engine.

context.description: Dynamic-workflow-engine extension. Per-node isolation pointer: the worktree path, the session-store session id, and the most recent checkpoint for resume.

workTreePath.description: Isolated filesystem root for this node (AF_WORKSPACE_ROOT/{workflowId}/{nodeId}).

sessionId.description: Session-store session id (interim sqlite | mnemos backend).

checkpoint.description: Resume point for this node; null until the first checkpoint is saved.

routing.description: Dynamic-workflow-engine extension (delta 6, explainable routing). The model-router decision for this node, mirrored into the ExecutionReceipt so GET /receipts/:id shows why a model was chosen. decision_id joins to a Maestro RouteDecision when consumed.

reason.description: Human-readable why (task class → model rule, or fallback trigger).

fallbackChain.description: Ordered registry model ids the router would fall through on failure.

decision_id.description: Maestro RouteDecision.decision_id when the model call was routed through Maestro; null otherwise. Carried to the receipt for the explainability join.
